fib: ______ is a general term for factors that make one intent on a particular behaviour.
Motivation

______ is the degree to which a source - receiver pair are similar in certain attributes such as education, belief, socialization etc.
Homophily
Homophily Versus heterophily - Homophily is the degree to which a source - receiver pair are similar in certain attributes such as education, belief, socialization etc.
______ is a control device and an important parameter or indicator of the success of communication as well as areas requiring modification and additional enquiry.
Feedback
Feedback is a control device and an important parameter or indicator of the success of communication as well as areas requiring modification and additional enquiry.

audiences
The audiences are those whom the source / sender wish to receive, understand and use the idea.

Farmers
Farmers are referred to as adult learners and extension workers as teachers.

demonstration

receiver
Receiver - The receiver is the target or audience of communication.

Heterophily

Exhibits

Empathy
